system.description:
When the dice turn on you — or on someone at your side — you can reach out and bend that luck back in your favour. A natural 1 becomes a natural 20, like fate just changed its mind. (Spend 2 Luck; usable on yourself or an ally within 30ft.)

Available to: Rogues, Assassins, Rangers, Monks, Archers, Gunslingers, Swashbucklers, and Artificers.
